description: This file contains LESS mixins for hiding text in CSS, including a deprecated old mixin and a newer one, related to accessibility/image replacement strategies.

methods.name: .hide-text()
methods.description: Mixin to hide text visually while keeping it accessible for screen readers, by setting font and background to hidden styles.

methods.name: .text-hide()
methods.description: Newer mixin that calls .hide-text(), introduced in v3.0.1 as a replacement for the deprecated .hide-text().
